selection_rule: strongest N by theoretical depth inside the band, min separation 4.0 A (select_lines) — OUR selection, not AGSS21's adopted set. Line selection is the dominant lever (RYA-842), so the indicator overlap is reported per product.

products.gf_rung: gf rung 2 (gf scale (cited NIST class)): all 5 C I lines carry a NIST ASD accuracy class (RMS 0.1450 dex over classes B, C, E). ⚠️ COMPILATION, NOT LABORATORY: no primary-laboratory gf table exists for C I and none will — the accepted standard for the light elements is critically-evaluated theory (Opacity Project / MCHF, RYA-1172) — so rung 3 is structurally unreachable and this is the pool's true ceiling
